records.name: Health Services Management Research
records.scope_notes: Fits health-service management research, substantive theory/methods advances and rigorous evidence synthesis. Studies need management implications; theory-to-practice work needs reliable impact assessment and generalizable lessons. Listed scientific formats have external peer review; perspectives and nonscientific pieces have exceptions. Preprints are considered; supply the DOI, disclose them and do not update them during journal evaluation. Substantive GenAI use requires disclosure and output verification; the publisher prohibits specified content/data uses. Independent authors are eligible, subject to possible additional integrity documentation.

route.conditions: Standard subscription route has no submission or publication fee. Optional Sage Choice OA and specifically requested print color cost extra; online color is free. Research, substantive theory/methods, evidence syntheses and theory-to-practice papers have 6,000-word limits; follow the separate limits for other formats.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No compulsory membership, registration, page or overlength payment is stated for manuscripts within the article limits; journal policy expressly excludes submission and publication fees.

records.name: Scandinavian Journal of Public Health
records.scope_notes: Public health original research, literature reviews and study-design papers. Existing-data population research and synthesis are relevant. The free route can substantially constrain review length because the printed-page threshold includes references, tables and figures.

route.conditions: Select standard subscription publication and keep original, review or design articles within five printed pages, counting abstract, tables, figures and references. Above five pages the mandatory charge is GBP 80 or USD 100 per excess page excluding VAT. Word limits alone do not establish free eligibility: reviews may allow 6000 words yet exceed five printed pages. Optional OA and requested print colour cost extra. Sponsored supplements are excluded.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None within the five-printed-page route without optional print colour/OA. Mandatory excess-page charges apply beyond five pages; supplement authors/sponsors fund supplement costs.

fee_evidence.note: Complete current journal instructions state no submission/publication fees, then impose GBP 80/USD 100 per printed page above five for original/review/design articles, excluding VAT; optional OA, requested print colour and supplements have separate costs.
